summary: subversion options: checkout, dest, executable, export, force to discard changes, in_place, password (leaks via argv before svn 1.10), repo, revision, switch, update and username.
questions: How do I export an SVN tree without .svn metadata?
How do I check out a specific SVN revision?
Is passing an svn password safe?
What happens if there are local modifications?

answer_card.title: subversion parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `repo` (required), `dest`
- `revision` (HEAD, aliases `rev`, `version`)
- `export` (no): export instead of checkout
- `force` (no): discard modifications (otherwise fails)
- `in_place` (no): checkout over existing dir
- `username`, `password`: before svn 1.10 password leaks into argv; 1.10+ uses stdin
- `checkout`, `update`, `switch` (yes)
